description: Generate the exact GitHub Actions workflow needed to enforce AgentScore Policy Gate for a repo. Detects MCP dependencies locally and returns the OIDC-based YAML needed for setup. No API key or secret is required.

path.description: Optional path to the repo root. Defaults to the current working directory.

repo_url.description: Optional repository URL override for the pilot handoff link.

name: generate_policy_gate_setup
